info.title: snapdragon-user-bff-api
info.description: User BFF API (/bff/user/**) — owner-scoped profile, home-guide preferences, federation-bundle cards, self-blocking, and instance-block recommendation. Every endpoint is keyed to the caller's Casdoor JWT subject.

tags.name: Home guide
tags.description: Per-user home/getting-started guide dismissal (owner = JWT subject).

tags.name: Media-cloak
tags.description: Poison-before-ingest media proxy (owner = JWT subject). Best-effort AI-cloak — 'AI-cloak applied', never 'protected' unless the round-trip survival gate passes.

tags.name: Character-stickers
tags.description: The caller's OWN VN-character expression stickers (owner = JWT subject). Each is a rendered PNG, edge-AI moderated before publish and reviewed by a moderator.

tags.name: SSO auth
tags.description: Native login (server-side credential check) / register / session. Ships dark behind app.bff.oidc.enabled.

tags.name: Character-parts
tags.description: The caller's OWN user-drawn character parts (owner = JWT subject). SVG is server-sanitized before storage and reviewed by a moderator.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: The caller's OWN profile (owner = JWT subject). Password/email go to the Casdoor IdP.

tags.name: Notifications (TEST-SEED, self only)
tags.description: TEST/SEED-ONLY. Ships dark behind app.test-seed.enabled (default false). Creates a real in-app notification for the CALLER ONLY via the same delivery service the production ROLE_SERVICE internal-deliver path uses — never a parallel write.

tags.name: Self-block
tags.description: The caller's OWN blocks (owner = JWT subject) + instance-block recommendation.

tags.name: Mesh-devices
tags.description: The caller's OWN claimed Meshtastic LoRa radio node ids (owner = JWT subject). Node ids are globally unique — one owner per radio.

tags.name: Notification preferences
tags.description: Per-category notification preferences (owner = JWT subject, domain-scoped). account-restriction is forced-on / un-silenceable.

tags.name: Matrix proxy (D6)
tags.description: Owner-scoped Matrix reverse-proxy; injects the server-held homeserver-native token. Live by default behind app.hs-token.enabled.

tags.name: Cards
tags.description: The caller's OWN federation bundles (owner = JWT subject), via snapdragon-federation-api.

tags.name: Mesh-devices (internal bridge)
tags.description: SERVICE-PRINCIPAL ONLY: the full node-id → Matrix-localpart mapping (active rows only) + the batch LoRa status write-back for the mesh↔Matrix bridge.

tags.name: Self-silence
tags.description: Self-service visibility hide (owner = JWT subject). NOT a ban: no role/suspension/revocation.

tags.name: Account status
tags.description: Polling endpoint for the caller's own account status (roles, domain, silence).

tags.name: Character-moderation (internal receiver)
tags.description: SERVICE-PRINCIPAL ONLY part/sticker status flip (PENDING→ACTIVE/REJECTED) when a moderator resolves the finding. PENDING-guarded + idempotent (a no-op/unknown id is a 404).

tags.name: Mastodon proxy (D6)
tags.description: Owner-scoped Mastodon reverse-proxy; injects the server-held homeserver-native token. Live by default behind app.hs-token.enabled.

tags.name: Notifications (in-app floor)
tags.description: The caller's OWN in-app notifications (owner = JWT subject, domain-scoped). The always-on in-app channel — read + mark-read only; the actions reconciler writes them.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: The caller's OWN active login sessions (owner = JWT-derived account). List + revoke.

tags.name: User preferences
tags.description: Durable per-user UI preferences (owner = JWT subject, domain-scoped). Carries media.poison.default (the per-user AI-poison default the compose toggle persists) and the mastodon.appearance.* keys (the mastodon-ui appearance panel).

tags.name: Connected clients
tags.description: The caller's OWN connected apps + device sessions (owner = JWT subject). Requires an external-client role.

tags.name: Notifications (internal deliver)
tags.description: SERVICE-PRINCIPAL ONLY in-app notification delivery (target taken from the body). Honours prefs (account-restriction forced-on) and is idempotent on the source event.

get.summary: Get my profile (owner = JWT subject).

put.summary: Create/update my profile. The body's userId is ignored — the owner is the JWT subject; the vanity username is derived from the token.

get.summary: My durable preferences (server defaults merged in for unset keys).

put.summary: Upsert one of my durable preferences (returns the resolved view).

get.summary: My notification preferences (defaults merged in; account-restriction always enabled).

put.summary: Upsert one notification-category preference (returns the resolved view). account-restriction enabled=false is coerced to true.
Change who may see MY device's LoRa status (private|friends|channels). Frozen on a revoked device (409); a device that is not mine is a 404.

200.description: Visibility updated; the device is returned.

404.description: No such mesh device for this user (foreign/unknown id — no existence leak).

409.description: Device is revoked — visibility cannot be changed.

put.summary: Dismiss the named guide for me (PUT alias of /dismiss).

post.summary: Dismiss the named guide for me (idempotent).

delete.summary: Re-show (un-dismiss) the named guide for me.

get.summary: List versions of one of my cards by slug.

put.summary: Publish (create/update) a card bundle for a slug.
put.description: Body is the single entry file (octet-stream). federation-api content-hashes it, records a user_modules row under ME (forwarded JWT), and supersedes the prior version.

delete.summary: Delete one of my cards by slug.
delete.description: Proxies federation-api's owner-scoped DELETE: removes the caller's OWN current bundle for the slug (federation-api removes the storage version + supersedes the row). Owner-enforced upstream via the forwarded JWT (a non-owner gets 404 from federation-api).

post.summary: Email a mod/admin to reactivate me sooner (writes a self-silence-appeal request; NOT SMTP).
Cancel my self-silence now (un-hide + clear).
Activate my self-silence (hide me from others until expiresAt). I keep my own access.
Recommend an instance block (starts the USER->MOD->ADMIN chain via federation-api). Requires a platform role.

200.description: Instance-block recommendation submitted to federation-api. Starts the USER->MOD->ADMIN chain.

403.description: Caller lacks ROLE_MATRIX or ROLE_MASTODON (API leg + service leg re-check).

502.description: federation-api unreachable or returned an error.

post.summary: Change my Casdoor password (goes to the IdP, not the profile table).
Change my Casdoor email (goes to the IdP, not the profile table).

Upload my profile picture (multipart 'file'). The bytes are stored on the Matrix homeserver media repo (stub-gated) and the mxc:// URL is saved on my profile; the refreshed profile is returned. Owner = JWT subject.
Mark one of MY notifications read (404 if not my own row).
TEST/SEED-ONLY: create a real in-app notification for the CALLING user (self only), through the production delivery service. 503 when app.test-seed.enabled=false (ships dark).

get.summary: List my claimed mesh devices (newest first; revoked rows included with state + reason; bridge-reported LoRa status fields included).

200.description: The caller's own mesh devices (may be empty).

post.summary: Claim a Meshtastic LoRa node id (owner = JWT subject). Accepts 'a1b2c3d4' / '!A1B2C3D4'; stores the canonical '!'+lowercase form. A node id already registered by anyone is a 409.

200.description: Node id claimed; the persisted device is returned (canonical nodeId, visibility 'private', state 'active').

400.description: Missing/malformed nodeId (not 8 hex digits with an optional '!' prefix) or label over 64 chars.

409.description: Node id already registered on this platform (by anyone, any domain, active or revoked — one owner per radio).

500.description: Database error writing the claim row.

post.summary: Upload media through the cloak proxy (poison-then-forward).
post.description: Multipart: file (required) + platform (matrix|mastodon) + mode (glaze|nightshade|light|none, default from server) + roomId/description (passthrough). Returns the homeserver response verbatim + the server-owned cloak decision.

post.summary: Deliver one in-app notification to the target user (SERVICE-principal only; prefs honoured, account-restriction forced-on, idempotent on the source event).

Batch LoRa status write-back from the bridge (SERVICE-principal only). Fail-soft per element: unknown node ids / revoked rows are counted 'ignored'; out-of-range telemetry is clamped. Returns {updated, ignored}.
Flip a PENDING expression STICKER to ACTIVE/REJECTED on finding resolution (SERVICE-principal only; idempotent — an unknown/already-resolved id is a 404).
Flip a PENDING character PART to ACTIVE/REJECTED on finding resolution (SERVICE-principal only; idempotent — an unknown/already-resolved id is a 404).

get.summary: List MY VN-character expression stickers (newest first). Owner = JWT subject.

post.summary: Save a VN-character expression sticker (multipart 'file' = the rendered PNG + 'expression' = a canonical label). The bytes are magic-byte-sniffed (a non-raster/SVG is a 400), size-capped, edge-AI moderated (a blocked sticker is a 422), uploaded to the homeserver media repo, stored status=PENDING, and queued for moderation. Owner = JWT subject.

get.summary: List MY character parts (newest first). Owner = JWT subject.

post.summary: Save a user-drawn character part. The SVG is server-sanitized (a malformed/non-svg body is a 422), stored status=PENDING, and queued for moderation. Owner = JWT subject.

get.summary: List my self-blocks.

200.description: The caller's own self-blocks (may be empty).

post.summary: Create a self-block (durable row + best-effort external push). Platform-role gated.
post.description:
Records a durable user_block row under the JWT subject, then best-effort pushes to the external homeserver (Matrix/Mastodon; STUBBED by default). The row is the source of truth even if the external push is stubbed or fails.

Caller-role access matrix

PlatformRequired role (API leg + service leg)
internal (or absent)ROLE_USER floor — no platform role needed
matrixROLE_MATRIX (platform access role)
mastodonROLE_MASTODON (platform access role)
The rule is enforced by @PreAuthorize (API leg) AND re-checked in BlockService (service leg / defence-in-depth).

200.description: Block recorded. 'pushed' indicates whether a live external push ran. 'external' is 'live', 'stubbed', or 'n/a'.

400.description: Missing target, blank platform, or platform not in matrix|mastodon|internal.

403.description: ROLE_MATRIX required for platform=matrix; ROLE_MASTODON for platform=mastodon (API leg + service leg re-check).

500.description: Database error writing the block row.

post.summary: Email-provider registration: ensure the account. 503 when the SSO surface is dark.

Native login: verify username+password SERVER-SIDE at Casdoor, then exchange the code, provision the account+session and set the bff_ cookie. 200 {registrationComplete,status,mfaRequired:false} on success; 200 {mfaRequired:true} when a second factor is needed (no cookie); 401 invalid_credentials on bad creds. 503 when the SSO surface is dark.

get.summary: Caller's own account status — active roles, domain scope, and self-silence state.
List my active login sessions (owner = JWT-derived account; ids are opaque fingerprints, never the raw session token).
My self-silence status (active or cleared).
My in-app notifications (newest first, server-capped).
Real-time notification event stream (SSE). Client reconnects on close.
My cloak decision for a media ref (badge polling), owner-scoped.
AI-cloak capability (worker backend + modes + ETA) for the shield state.
FULL mesh-device mapping for the bridge (SERVICE-principal only; every ACTIVE claim across all owners and domains). Rows whose owner's Matrix localpart cannot be resolved are omitted (fail-soft).
Is the named guide dismissed for me? (default guide = 'home')
List my connected apps + device sessions (owner = JWT subject). Requires an external-client role.

200.description: The caller's connected apps + device sessions. Merges durable audit rows with live homeserver read (best-effort, may be empty when seams are stubbed).

get.summary: Serve MY stored, SANITIZED part SVG as a hardened image (image/svg+xml + locked-down CSP). A part that is not mine is a 404. Owner = JWT subject.
List my cards (my federation bundles).
Read my card's current body (source) by slug — for Edit pre-fill.
get.description: Proxies federation-api's owner-scoped read-my-card-body so the WYSIWYG editor can RE-READ a card's current source to edit it. Owner-enforced upstream via the forwarded JWT (a non-owner gets 404 from federation-api). Returns the raw entry-file bytes.

get.summary: The caller's session view (from admin-bff), read from the bff_ cookie. PermitAll + cookie-authenticated (NO JWT) so the login SPA can hydrate its session straight after login — when the browser holds only the bff_ cookie, not a gateway-minted JWT (which is what /me requires). Same body as /me. 401 when there is no session; 503 when the SSO surface is dark.

delete.summary: Revoke the caller's session (sessionOut) and expire the bff_ cookie. 503 when the SSO surface is dark.

get.summary: The caller's account view (from admin-bff). Authenticated. 503 when the SSO surface is dark.

delete.summary: Revoke one of my sessions by its opaque id. A foreign/unknown id is a generic 404 (anti-enumeration). Revoking my own current session is allowed.
Release one of MY mesh-device claims (scoped to me + id). Releasing a REVOKED row is allowed and frees the node id.

404.description: No such mesh device for this user (or wrong domain).

delete.summary: Revoke one of my connected clients (per-credential gateway key + best-effort homeserver delete + audit stamp).
delete.description: Revokes one of the caller's own connected clients by its audit-row id. Revocation order: (1) write the per-credential gateway key hs::: (gateway denies future use within ≤5s), (2) best-effort DELETE at the homeserver, (3) stamp revoked_at on the audit row. All three steps are owner+domain scoped. Steps 2 and 3 are best-effort; the gateway key is the durable enforcement.

200.description: Client revoked. 'revocationKey' is 'written' or 'stubbed'; 'upstream' is 'live' or 'stubbed'.

400.description: id is not a valid UUID.

403.description: Caller lacks the external-client role for the client's platform (service leg re-check).

404.description: No such active connected client for this user.

409.description: Caller's account has no persisted homeserver localpart yet (fail-closed localpart resolution).

delete.summary: Remove one of my self-blocks (scoped to me + id).

400.description: id is not a valid UUID.

404.description: No such block for this user (or wrong domain).
